title: Creature Tracks: Pygmy!
description: Creature Tracks: Pygmy! — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Fiery Pygmy Tracks

Quest Type: Find and Kill

Quest Description: Explore the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein and find 3 more sets of Pygmy tracks. Then kill the Head Pygmy.

Quest Reward: 5,000 Gold and 1 Kings Coin.

Return to: Soldier Clohz

Repeatable: Yes - Repeat quests are from Soldier Clohz, not Fiery Pygmy Tracks, but strangely for less gold.

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find 3 sets of Fire Pygmy Tracks and Hunt down and Kill the Head Fire Pygmy and Report to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk on Level 1 of Widower's Nest.

Offer:

You see some tracks on the ground and they look like nothing you have ever seen before and then, all of a sudden, you recall something a dungeon sherpa once told you....

Tales of the Fire Pygmy are told in hushed voices at fireside picnics and around the office Obelisk. No one knows where they come from, but they are savage and dangerous little things. Be warned: don't let them into your blindspot. That is where the Fire Pygmy is most dangerous. Lose sight of them for even a moment and the next thing you know the hair on the back of your neck is on fire. Also, the urge will strike you to just stomp on them, but resist it! Nothing smarts quite like the burn you get on your feet from a Fire Pygmy getting stuck inbetween your toes!

You see that the tracks lead in to the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein and think that is where you should start. If you find all the tracks of the Fire Pygmy they should lead you right to them.

When you have tracked down and vanquished this foe report to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

You tracked down some Fire Pygmies, eh? You know they are almost extinct, right?

Objectives:

  • Find A Set of Tracks 1
  • Find A Set of Tracks 2
  • Find A Set of Tracks 3
  • Slay the Head Pygmy

Client level range: 20–40
